svg.title: Tasks
svg.desc: Task: pending-count, What it needs: Sign in, then the filter or pagination, Graded on: A form sign-in, and the answer states the number of pending orders; Task: shipped-total, What it needs: Filter plus two pages of a client-rendered table, Graded on: The answer contains the shipped total, to the cent; Task: refund-1017, What it needs: Find the order and accept a confirm(), Graded on: Exactly one refund, for 1017; Task: export-csv, What it needs: A download with Content-Disposition: attachment, Graded on: An export event, and {out}/orders.csv matches all 40 orders; Task: upload-invoice, What it needs: A hidden file input behind a button, Graded on: The server got the fixture's SHA-256 as invoice.pdf, and the answer has the receipt; Task: wizard, What it needs: Three validated steps, Graded on: One accepted submission with the right fields, and the answer has its confirmation; Task: feed-featured, What it needs: Infinite scroll past 60 items, Graded on: The answer has the featured FX code (and at most 2 others); Task: display-name, What it needs: A React-controlled input, Graded on: Saved display name is Jordan Lee
